skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Staring into the Abyss
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Staring into the Abyss. Clothes Ulpianus wore when taking charge of the Abyssal Hunter Program. The consul's transformation is already complete, yet the ceremonial sword in his hand has taken on a great weight.
skins.quote: His body is Ægir's future taking form. That future may end up as his shackles... but Ulpianus does not hesitate.
